blocks.text: 🪝 MHA Cyber Fraud Report: Uttar Pradesh Records Highest Complaints in India (1.85 Lakh Cases). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Records 12.71 lakh total cyber fraud complaints across India between January and June 2026.
State Cases Ranking: Uttar Pradesh recorded highest complaints (1.85 lakh), followed by Maharashtra (1.58 lakh) and Karnataka (1.21 lakh).
Financial Loss Ranking: Maharashtra recorded highest financial loss (₹1,637.66 crore), followed by Karnataka (₹1,097.37 crore).
Highest complaint volume state (Uttar Pradesh) vs highest financial loss state (Maharashtra).
